verdict.rationale: Portkey's core LLM-gateway functionality (routing, fallbacks, caching, retries, load balancing) is fully API/config driven via the inference API and gateway config, giving strong API parity for request-level operations. However, administrative and governance features (budgets, rate limits, model catalog, org/workspace controls, log viewing/sharing) are described as dashboard/UI actions in the docs, and no OpenAPI/control-plane API spec was found (openapi probe all 404), suggesting a gap in API-driven management of these settings.
